name: Only One 2 ~Meshimase Megumi no Sweet Apron~
original_name: オンリーワン2 ～召しませ 恵のすぃ～とエプロン～
source:
Main character finishes chef training in Europe and returns back to his home town. His parents die in a traffic accident leaving him a western-style restaurant "Hidden Rabbit". He's good at cooking, but he totally fails as a manager, so he calls a female childhood friend to take this position. Alas, she's no good as a waitress. They find a cheerful waitress to chase their dreams together.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在欧洲完成厨师修行后回到故乡。他的父母因交通事故去世，留给他一家名为‘隐兔亭’的西餐厅。他厨艺出色，却完全不懂经营，于是请青梅竹马前来担任经理。遗憾的是，她也不擅长服务员的工作。后来，两人找到了一位性格开朗的服务员，三人决定共同追逐梦想。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
